products.name: Porsche 911 GT3 RS (992)
products.description: Exquisite 1:18 scale replica of the 992-generation Porsche 911 GT3 RS. Features openable doors, hood, detail-accurate flat-six engine bay, functional steering, and active rear wing replica.

products.name: Nissan Skyline GT-R (R34) Z-Tune
products.description: Highly detailed 1:24 die-cast model of the legendary Nismo R34 GT-R Z-Tune in iconic Bayside Blue. Includes detailed RB26DETT engine replication and custom gold Nismo wheels.

products.name: Aston Martin DB5 (1964)
products.description: The ultimate classic spy car. This 1:18 replica of the 1964 Aston Martin DB5 features a metallic silver-birch finish, detailed wire wheels, and a replica luxurious leather-trimmed interior.

products.name: Shelby Mustang GT500 'Eleanor'
products.description: Stunning 1:18 scale model of the 1967 Shelby Mustang GT500 'Eleanor'. Finished in gunmetal grey with black racing stripes. High-quality die-cast metal with opening parts.

products.name: Ferrari LaFerrari
products.description: Officially licensed 1:24 scale replica of Ferrari's hybrid hypercar. Features opening butterfly doors, detailed hybrid powertrain visual, and signature Rosso Corsa paint job.

products.name: Toyota AE86 Trueno (Initial D)
products.description: 1:24 scale model replica of the famous Fujiwara Tofu Shop AE86 Trueno. Includes the tofu delivery cup holder cup, pop-up headlights, and black-and-white panda livery.

products.name: Chevrolet Camaro Z28 (1969)
products.description: Aggressive 1:24 scale replica of the 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Z28. Authentic paint schemes, heavy diecast body, opening doors and hood revealing the detailed V8 engine.

products.name: Jaguar E-Type Roadster
products.description: Charming 1:43 replica of the classic British Roadster, once called 'the most beautiful car ever made' by Enzo Ferrari. Detailed chrome spoke wheels and red leather trim.

tickets.subject: AE86 pop-up lights query
tickets.message: Hi, does the pop-up headlights on the 1:24 AE86 model have actual working LED lights or are they manual flip-up only?

replies.message: Hello Alex! The headlights are manual flip-up only. There are no LEDs installed in this specific model. However, the detailing inside the lenses is extremely realistic!
Awesome, thanks for the quick reply. Manual flip-up is perfect!
